courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 飛機雷擊防護架構
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「融化潛熱與供熱下限」推進到「供電負載與轉換損失」，最後以「情境邊界與未驗證區交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Latent heat and minimum melting input through Power supply and conversion loss to Scenario boundaries and unverified-region handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 飛機除冰防冰系統
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「融化潛熱與供熱下限」推進到「供電負載與轉換損失」，最後以「情境邊界與未驗證區交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Latent heat and minimum melting input through Power supply and conversion loss to Scenario boundaries and unverified-region handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「分離結冰形成、熱量需求、覆蓋與異常監測」為主線，在防冰除冰軟體熱量與覆蓋模型中依序完成融化潛熱與供熱下限、表面導熱路徑、供電負載與轉換損失、加熱覆蓋與取樣盲點、加熱區共用供電的依賴及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Separate icing formation, energy demand, coverage and monitoring in a Software anti-icing/deicing energy and coverage model, progressing through Latent heat and minimum melting input, Surface conduction path, Power supply and conversion loss, Heating coverage and sampling blind spots, Shared power dependencies across heating zones, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
